description: This file contains utility functions and logic for handling Google-specific message sanitization, session history management, schema validation, and plugin integrations within a larger AI agent framework. It includes functions for fixing message order, canonicalizing assistant messages, managing session snapshots, and handling Google model-specific quirks.

methods.name: buildInterSessionPrefix
methods.description: Constructs a prefix string for inter-session messages based on message provenance.

methods.name: annotateInterSessionUserMessages
methods.description: Adds inter-session prefixes to user messages with provenance information.

methods.name: describeAssistantContentKind
methods.description: Returns a string describing the type of assistant message content.

methods.name: canonicalizeAssistantHistoryMessages
methods.description: Repairs malformed assistant messages to ensure they conform to a canonical array-based format.

methods.name: parseMessageTimestamp
methods.description: Parses a timestamp value from string or number to a finite number or null.

methods.name: stripStaleAssistantUsageBeforeLatestCompaction
methods.description: Removes or zeroes out assistant usage data before the latest compaction point.

methods.name: normalizeAssistantUsageSnapshot
methods.description: Normalizes assistant usage data into a consistent format.

methods.name: normalizeAssistantUsageCost
methods.description: Extracts and normalizes cost information from usage data.

methods.name: toFiniteCostNumber
methods.description: Converts a value to a finite number if possible.

methods.name: ensureAssistantUsageSnapshots
methods.description: Ensures all assistant messages have normalized usage snapshots.
